name: HoneyVolt Slim Power Bank - Sky Blue Mist
product_summary: HoneyVolt Slim Power Bank - Sky Blue Mist is a portable charging backup that keeps compatible daily devices charged away from outlets.
verified_facts: The HoneyVolt Slim Power Bank in Sky Blue Mist, a 10,000mAh all-in-one charger with built-in cables, in a soft pastel blue finish. A 10,000mAh / 37Wh Li-Polymer power bank with built-in Lightning and USB-C cables, plus additional USB-A and USB-C ports so you can charge up to 4 devices at once. USB-C input is 5V/3A or 9V/2A (18W max); USB-C output reaches PD 20W; USB-A output reaches 22.5W. Slim profile at approximately 147 x 69 x 18mm and 235g. Finished in Sky Blue Mist for a soft, elegant paste
core_benefits: keeps compatible daily devices charged away from outlets
adds compact charging continuity for travel and daily carry
